meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问式对话完善计划或设计，并同步生成 ADR 与术语表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在推进复杂方案时犹豫不决，需要有人帮你挖出逻辑漏洞并留下清晰记录。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pressure-test complex designs and keep a clear decision trail.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会跑一场 /grilling 访谈,并调用 /domain-modeling 技能:就你的方案或设计不断追问,过程中同时产出两类文档——ADR 和术语表。该技能需手动调用,不会自动触发。
howto.when: 原文写明它禁用了模型自动调用(disable-model-invocation),只能由你手动发起;当你想打磨一个方案或设计时,启动 /grilling 会话即进入。

say.text: 用 /grilling 帮我打磨这个方案
say.note: 会开始追问,并同步产出 ADR 和术语表

say.text: 对我的设计跑一场 grilling 访谈
say.note: 过程中会生成 ADR 和术语表

say.text: 用 domain-modeling 技能开一场追问式访谈
say.note: 围绕你的方案连续追问并记录文档

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a /grilling session using the /domain-modeling skill: it interviews you about a plan or design and, as it goes, creates docs — ADRs and a glossary. It is manual-invocation only.
howto.when_en: The description sets disable-model-invocation: true, so it never triggers on its own; start it yourself by running a /grilling session when you want a plan or design sharpened.

say_en.note: It starts interviewing and creates ADRs and a glossary

say_en.text: Do a grilling session on my design
say_en.note: ADRs and a glossary get produced along the way

say_en.text: Use the domain-modeling skill for an interview
say_en.note: It questions the plan and writes docs as it goes
